findings.title: managed interactive turn continuations are rejected after they run
findings.exposure: An awaiting-user managed call with a turn continuation ends COULD_NOT_RUN when two UserPromptSubmit callbacks are recorded.
findings.reproduction: Use a frozen policy containing a turn step and replay the initial and continuation UserPromptSubmit callbacks before managed finish.

findings.title: changed cap, replay, and managed-continuation paths lack discriminating coverage
findings.exposure: The newly enabled interactive path can regress in allocation, replay, managed chronology, or signal-exit admission without a focused synthetic test catching it.
findings.reproduction: Inspect candidate tests: only the new fixture module references interactive support, and it covers one answer and a zero-step fake server.

unobserved: managed callback chronology and callback origin
